title: Reflection sheet
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 102 (Reflection sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 102: Editing my assessed piece and reflecting on Year 4. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Edit: We saw the sea. It was big. We were happy.

parts.text: Combine: When we saw the sea, ...
Show feeling: Musa laughed and raced to the water.
Result: When we saw the vast, glittering sea, Musa laughed and raced to the water.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: An edited sentence with more effect

panels.title: My Year 5 target
points: Write it on the reflection sheet

keywords.def: improve writing by changing words and fixing errors
how a word or sentence makes the reader feel

questions.q: Upgrade a verb in your piece and say why
questions.a: For example: went to wandered, because it shows they were relaxed

questions.q: Core: make three edits that improve your assessed piece (use a different colour)
Extend: compare your first January piece with today's and write three improvements
Stretch: write your Year 5 target with a reason
questions.a: For example: use more varied sentence openers, because many of mine start with Then

questions.q: Which edit improves the sentence most?
options: Adding a precise verb: we trudged
questions.a: C) Adding a precise verb: we trudged. A precise verb adds meaning; repeating very or changing size does not.
